texts.en:
Some among us have started to behave abnormally, exhibiting sudden changes in opinions, habits, and general conduct. Many [Owner.GetWorkerNamePlural] have ceased labor, and [Owner.GetOutOfControlExtra].

Those affected claim to be doing the bidding of a nameless entity that dwells in the peripheries of their consciousness, guiding their every action. As we continue to forge our psionic future, we must carefully consider the impact of extradimensional forces on [Owner.GetOutOfControlPsyche].

label.zh: 我们可以学着控制这种冲动。
label.en: We can learn to mitigate these impulses.

label.zh: 这些心声会教会我们很多。
label.en: These voices have much to teach us.

label.zh: 对我们政权的威胁。掐灭它。
label.en: A threat to our authority. Stamp it out.
